people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”
translations.bsb: “Lord,” said Peter, “are You addressing this parable to us, or to everyone else as well?”
translations.kjv: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?
translations.asv: And Peter said, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even unto all?
